tagline.en_US: Minisatip is a multi-threaded satip server version 1.2 that runs under Linux and it was tested with DVB-S, DVB-S2, DVB-T, DVB-T2, DVB-C, DVB-C2, ATSC and ISDB-T cards.

description.en_US: Minisatip is a multi-threaded SAT>IP server designed for Linux systems. It streams digital television signals across a local network and supports DVB-S, DVB-S2, DVB-T, DVB-T2, DVB-C, DVB-C2, ATSC, and ISDB-T tuner cards. The application allows tuner hardware to be shared with network-connected clients and media server platforms like TVHeadend.
